title: Implement ShoppingList Checklist View
description: Create `ShoppingList` and `ShoppingListItem` in one source file, with raw text storage plus a computed checklist-item view derived from the GFM checklist regex and line indices.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingList.swift` defines `ShoppingList` and `ShoppingListItem` with the public API from the spec.
`items` recomputes checklist items from `text` on each access in document order.
Checklist detection honours `^\s*-\s+\[([ xX])\]\s+(.+)$`, records 0-based `lineIndex`, and preserves the captured item text verbatim.
`ShoppingList(text).text == text` remains true for any input.

handoff_summary.completed: Added `Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/ShoppingList.swift` defining the spec API: raw `text` storage, computed `items` using `^\s*-\s+\[([ xX])\]\s+(.+)$`, 0-based `lineIndex`, verbatim captured item text, plus `toggle(itemAt:)`, `appendItem(_:)`, and `removeItem(atLine:)` helpers that operate on checklist lines while preserving other content.
handoff_summary.risks: `swift build --target CookbookCore` could not be completed in this sandbox because SwiftPM manifest evaluation hit `sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted`. I only verified the new source file with `swiftc -typecheck`.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. Work is isolated to the new `ShoppingList.swift` file in the expected scope.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a single-file implementation with an internal regex and explicit line-range scanning so `items` is recomputed from `text` on every access and the mutating helpers can preserve untouched document content byte-for-byte outside the targeted checklist line.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Per developer guardrails, no test suite was run. Validation was limited to `swiftc -typecheck Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/ShoppingList.swift`.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Line splitting is based on `\n`, which matches the spec and preserves raw text round-tripping, but full package compilation was not verifiable in this sandbox.

conflict_risks: Low. Work is isolated to the new `ShoppingList.swift` file in the expected scope.
